name: Unified Zero-Shot Turkish Text Classification Benchmark
description: A unified benchmark aggregating tasks and datasets to evaluate zero-shot Turkish text classification performance.
reputation: A focused benchmark aggregating Turkish classification tasks for zero-shot evaluation; recognized in Turkish NLP research but not widely used outside the language community.
notes: Language-specific zero-shot benchmark; potential issues include limited task diversity, variations in label sets across datasets, and contamination risk if multilingual models were pretrained on overlapping Turkish corpora.
